title: Promotion card prints "Pinned to" as a raw ISO timestamp
body:
## Summary
evolutionProposalToTriage's lockedAt fact carries proposal.baseUpdatedAt verbatim and the Decision Deck's ledger now prints it as text, e.g. '2026-01-20T00:00:00.000Z'.

## Description
The fact `{ id: 'lockedAt', value: proposal.baseUpdatedAt }` (src/features/agents/quick-answer/triage/triageAdapters.ts:1146) was rendered as a relative time by a docked ledger that has since been removed - the adapter's own note says so (triageAdapters.ts:1293-1296). The live ledger (src/features/decision-center/deck/LedgerRail.tsx:39-43) filters facts equal to createdAt, which hides every 'raised' fact, but lockedAt is not createdAt, so FactLine (src/features/decision-center/deck/FactLine.tsx:29-34) prints the raw string. Fixed = the deck renders timestamp-valued fact ids (lockedAt) through RelativeTime / a date formatter, or the adapter formats it.

## Flow
- Darwin Mode files a promotion
- Decision Deck ledger: "Pinned to  2026-01-20T00:00:00.000Z"
- fix in the deck: render lockedAt via RelativeTime (out of this context)

## Expected impact
The expiry fact of the one expiring card reads as a time. Could break: nothing else reads lockedAt.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - raw ISO timestamps in the promotion ledger: 1 -> 0
Before: walked: lockedAt not filtered by LedgerRail.tsx:39-43 (only value === createdAt is), FactLine prints value verbatim
After: 0 raw timestamps (deck renders it as a time)
Method: simulation - code path walked across the adapter and the decision-center deck; the render seam is in another context
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/features/agents/quick-answer/triage/triageAdapters.ts:1146 `{ id: 'lockedAt', label: copy.evolutionLockFact, value: proposal.baseUpdatedAt }`
src/features/decision-center/deck/LedgerRail.tsx:39-43 plainFacts filter (f.value !== item.createdAt)
src/features/decision-center/deck/FactLine.tsx:33 `{fact.value}`
impact_why: Machine timestamp on a reviewer-facing card; the fact exists to say how stale the lock is.
predicted_why: no precedent (door decisions empty; none in cycle-1 git)
instrument: render LedgerRail with an evolution item; assert no text node matches /\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/

title: Question card falls back to a hardcoded English 'Untitled agent'
body:
## Summary
usePendingInteractions names an unresolved persona with the literal 'Untitled agent', which becomes the question card's source label and Persona fact, bypassing the translation tree.

## Description
src/features/agents/quick-answer/usePendingInteractions.ts:146 `personaName: p?.name ?? 'Untitled agent'` is outside JSX, so custom/no-hardcoded-jsx-text cannot see it; questionGroupToTriage puts it in the card's source label and Persona fact (src/features/agents/quick-answer/triage/triageAdapters.ts:887,890). Every other fallback the adapters print comes from TriageCopy. Fixed = the label comes from the translation tree (useTranslation in the hook).

## Flow
- a build session belongs to a persona not yet in the roster (roster loads on another clock)
- card source reads "Untitled agent" regardless of locale
- fix: t.<section>.untitled fallback

## Expected impact
Consistent with the i18n law. English-only UI today, so the visible change is nil. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - hardcoded user-facing English fallbacks in this context: 1 -> 0
Before: 1 (grep 'Untitled agent' in src: one hit, usePendingInteractions.ts:146)
After: 0
Method: probe - grep count; English-only UI means no visible delta to gate
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/features/agents/quick-answer/usePendingInteractions.ts:146 `personaName: p?.name ?? 'Untitled agent',`
grep -rn "'Untitled agent'" src -> 1 hit
impact_why: Convention conformance; no visible change while the UI ships English only.
predicted_why: no precedent (door decisions empty; none in cycle-1 git); CLAUDE.md: English-only since 2026-10-25, fix-as-you-touch

title: quickConfigTypes exports DAYS and MONTH_DAYS that nothing imports
body:
## Summary
Two exported constants in quickConfigTypes.ts have zero importers; the schedule pickers that once used them define their own.

## Description
src/features/agents/shared/quickConfig/quickConfigTypes.ts:10-18 (DAYS) and :25 (MONTH_DAYS) are exported; a grep of every import of quickConfigTypes (12 sites) names only EventSubscription, Frequency, INPUT_CLS, QuickConfigState and describeTriggerConfig. WhenQuick.tsx:19 declares its own WEEKDAYS. DAY_LABELS is used inside the file only. Fixed = delete the two constants (and drop DAY_LABELS' export).

## Flow
- grep imports of quickConfigTypes: no DAYS / MONTH_DAYS
- delete; tsc green

## Expected impact
Smaller public surface for a shared module. Could break: nothing (no importer).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - unused exports in quickConfigTypes: 2 -> 0
Before: 2 (grep of all 12 import sites)
After: 0, tsc exit 0
Method: probe - zero-consumer grep before, tsc after
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
grep -rn quickConfigTypes src | grep import -> 12 sites, none import DAYS or MONTH_DAYS
src/features/agents/shared/quickConfig/quickConfigTypes.ts:10 `export const DAYS = [`
src/features/agents/shared/quickConfig/quickConfigTypes.ts:25 `export const MONTH_DAYS = Array.from(...)`
impact_why: Dead exports in a shared module invite a second schedule-day vocabulary.
predicted_why: like 56c37402b2 (git, decision memory empty), built: "remove detectPlatformFromUrl, which no production code calls"

title: Four code comments claim the reject reason becomes a constraint memory
body:
## Summary
triageTypes.ts and triageAdapters.ts document a reason->memory loop the backend does not have, so the next maintainer builds on a false premise.

## Description
src/features/agents/quick-answer/triage/triageTypes.ts:140-144 and :157-161, and src/features/agents/quick-answer/triage/triageAdapters.ts:459-466 and :790-792, state that a rejected idea's reason becomes a `constraint` memory that stops scanners re-raising it. The backend memory writer never reads rejection_reason (src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/dev_tools.rs:808-826). Fixed = the comments say what is true today: the reason is stored on the row (rejection_reason) and the verdict (not the reason) becomes the memory; pointer to the backend line. Independent of whether the backend change (registry-conformance card) is accepted.

## Flow
- read the four comment sites
- read dev_tools.rs memory builder
- rewrite the four sentences

## Expected impact
Comments stop asserting a loop that does not exist. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - comment sites asserting reason->memory: 4 -> 0
Before: 4 (grep "constraint" in the two files, each re-read)
After: 0
Method: probe - grep count of the false claim; no behaviour to gate
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/features/agents/quick-answer/triage/triageAdapters.ts:790-792 'the backend turns a rejected idea's reason into a `constraint` memory'
src/features/agents/quick-answer/triage/triageTypes.ts:158-160 'the backend turns a rejected idea's reason into a `constraint` memory'
src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/dev_tools.rs:810-825 (no rejection_reason)
impact_why: Doc truth for a load-bearing claim the deck design rests on.
predicted_why: like 68b816163f (git, decision memory empty), built: "stale comment says the auto-match picks the first-indexed credential"
